subject: Multipath listing exception / onboarding playbook for Mux Digital
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: Rahul Agarwal <rahul@muxdigital.com>
Date: Sat, 11 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Marketplace onboarding - multipath listing exception for Mux Digital

Team —

High-level: Mux Digital is ready to list but hit a gating rule in our marketplace validation: their product requires a "multipath" entitlement model (per-tenant routing + shared billing hooks) that doesn't map cleanly to our current listing schema. Legal/ops flagged it as an "exception" because it touches entitlement mapping + billing hook responsibilities.

Why it matters: Mux is a mid-market ISV with a pilot customer that will drive a predictable $30k/mo ARR if we can list them this quarter. They can tolerate a short delay, but need clear owners and a rollback plan.

Asks (initial):
- Product (Karthik): quick feasibility on supporting per-tenant multipath entitlements and our billing hook model (API, webhook semantics, SSO binding). High-level estimate and blockers.
- Engineering/RTE (Jasmine): impact to marketplace onboarding flow (staging vs prod gating), any temporary bypass we can do without breaking telemetry.
- Partners (Laura/Monica): confirm commercial/contract flexibility and whether we can ship a limited listing (private beta listing) while we implement platform changes.

Attached: mux-integration-spec_v1.pdf (their requested entitlements + webhook flow), mux-test-tenant-credentials.txt (test tenant), sample redline.

Primary asks: owners + ETA for a decision by EOD Mon (7/13). If we can't decide, Sales will need to escalate to Accounts for potential concession.

-Ben

From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: Rahul Agarwal <rahul@muxdigital.com>
Date: Sat, 11 Jul 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Marketplace onboarding - multipath listing exception for Mux Digital

Thanks Ben — copied product and partners. Rahul, appreciate the spec; we'll triage internally and come back with a concrete playbook.

Initial plan:
1) Internal triage meeting: Mon 7/13 09:00 PT — we'll confirm attendees separately.
2) Short-term: explore a "private listing" approach so Mux can onboard pilot customers while we iterate on platform changes. This requires a gating override scoped to the specific deal + a telemetry flag for manual monitoring.
3) Long-term: evaluate extending our listing schema to support multipath routing and billing hooks across tenant scopes. Karthik, can you provide an initial tech feasibility note (bulleted) by EOD Sun (7/12)?

Rahul — if you can, please call out in the spec any absolute blockers vs. nice-to-haves (e.g., SSO binding required vs optional). That will help us prioritize.

I'll kick off a short Confluence page and a temp channel for the triage.

Thanks,
Jasmine
Lead, Partnerships Engineering
Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 11 Jul 2026 15:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Marketplace onboarding - multipath listing exception for Mux Digital

Jasmine / team —

Quick feasibility notes after scanning mux-integration-spec_v1.pdf:
- Multipath entitlement model: Technically feasible but requires two platform changes: (a) entitlement schema extension to express "route groups" (tenant-scoped routing rules) and (b) billing hook extension to include route-group id in webhook payloads.
- Backward compatibility: We can implement schema extension as opt-in (feature flag per-listing) so older listings remain unchanged.
- Effort estimate: ~3 sprint-weeks for a small core team (1 eng, 1 infra, 0.5 QA) to deliver a minimal API + webhook payload changes. End-to-end validation + docs add ~1 sprint-week.
- Risks: KV cache semantics for prefix caching may need adjustment if route groups increase cardinality; this could affect latency for high fanout customers. Also need to validate billing reconciliation for partial usage across a shared billing hook.

Immediate asks for product/infra decision:
1) Can we approve a private-beta listing flow (gating override) while feature flag dev proceeds? If yes, please confirm scope and any telemetry we must collect.
2) Is there appetite to prioritize this work this quarter (P2) vs next quarter (P3)? If P2, we need headcount allocation ASAP.

I can write a short RFC draft during the meeting on Mon; will include data model and sample webhook payloads.

-Karthik
Head of Product, Redwood Inference

From: Rahul Agarwal <rahul@muxdigital.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 12 Jul 2026 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Marketplace onboarding - multipath listing exception for Mux Digital

Thanks — helpful notes. To clarify from our side:
- Absolute blockers: SSO binding (tenant <-> listing) and ability for our webhook to receive a stable route_group_id. Those two are required for our billing reconciliation and tenant isolation.
- Nice-to-haves: per-tenant telemetry correlation fields in webhook, a preflight API to verify mapping for a given tenant (we can work around with metadata but prefer API).
- We can accept a private beta listing for a single pilot tenant if the gating override includes: a) a telemetry tag so we can monitor request flow, and b) a manual rollback path if reconciliation mismatches occur.

Test access: we uploaded a test tenant and credentials (see attachment). We can also stand up a temporary webhook receiver on port 8443 if you want to do an end-to-end smoke.

Happy to join the Monday triage.

-Rahul
Head of Platform Partnerships
Mux Digital

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 13 Jul 2026 09:00:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Marketplace onboarding - multipath listing exception for Mux Digital

Summary + action items from the internal sync:

Decisions:
- Approve short-term private-beta listing for Mux Digital limited to 1 pilot tenant (scope agreed with Rahul). This requires a gated override and telemetry tag as requested.
- Product to proceed with feature-flagged entitlement schema extension; target is to land core API changes by end of Q3 if we prioritize as P2.

Owners & deliverables:
- Jasmine Liu: create the gated-override workflow and telemetry tag by 7/16 (staging + prod checklist).
- Karthik Iyer: RFC + minimal data model + sample webhook payloads by 7/19. Dev estimate in RFC.
- Ben Carter: finalize commercial concession and sign-off (legal redline) by 7/15; coordinate with Rahul on the pilot SOW.
- Monica Patel: operational runbook for pilot onboarding and rollback by 7/18.

Attachments uploaded to the triage folder: mux-integration-spec_v1.pdf, mux-test-tenant-credentials.txt, multipath-exception-sample-contract_redlined.docx

Related links: HubSpot (DEAL-2026-0789) and the draft Confluence page: https://drive.company/redwood/mux/mux-integration-spec_v1.pdf.

Next meeting: checkpoint Wed 7/22 09:00 PT to review progress on RFC and gating workflow.

Thanks all — let's keep this tight, pilot unlocks a meaningful ARR stream.

-Laura
Director, Partner Success
Redwood Inference
